riley_csm: Standup at 10:30 to align on PulseHealth quickstart pilot 10m — owners, must-have success metrics, timeline, and any immediate renewal flags. In?
noah_pm: In. I'll own acceptance + sign-off.
ashley_enable: I'll do enablement + demo. Must-haves: e2e flow, one embedding spot-check, Console access for ops, and a 3-question feedback form.
sam_se: I'll prep sample payloads and a tiny canary. Heads-up: they asked about 12mo retention and encryption. Need to know if pilot requires that.
kai_eng: SSO is GA-only (~7 business days). Pilot fallback = token auth. If retention/PHI required for pilot we need DPA signed; that adds time. Logging both as risks.
riley_csm: Proposal: smoke tests within 48h, internal pilot end of week, customer pilot next Tue. Renewal watch: renewal ~11 months; recommend capture of week-1 usage to build value narrative.
noah_pm: Actions: @sam_se -> samples + README to s3://pulse/samples by 09:30 tomorrow; @kai_eng -> confirm SSO ETA in JIRA; @ashley_enable -> schedule 20m enablement and post the feedback link here. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
calendar-bot: Event created: "PulseHealth quickstart - kickoff" at 10:30. Attendees: riley_csm, noah_pm, ashley_enable, sam_se, kai_eng.
sam_se: Uploaded samples to s3://pulse/samples with README + curl/python snippets.
ashley_enable: Scheduling 20m (10m demo + 10m Qs). I'll post Confluence doc WIP and the feedback link after.
riley_csm: Quick draft checklist: `smoke: pass`, `p95 <350ms`, `embed_spotcheck >=0.9`, `docs_shared`, `week1_usage`. I'll formalize in Confluence and spin up daily 10m triage for the first 4 business days. Thanks team :rocket:
